title: Signal Sampler
text: Sample incoming signal at the edge of incoming clock, 4 inputs, 1 output; {Clock edge} determines when input signal is sampled, {Output mode} determines output sample, {Simulate using} selects simulation mode, {DecisionThresholdPort} sets the turn on decision threshold port, {Latch decision threshold} sets the voltage at which latched output switches, {Latch sensitivity} sets the voltage above or below decision threshold needed to assure that latched output switches to correct, {Symbol time (s)} sets the time of single symbol, {Sample interval (s)} sets the uniform time step, {Modulation (2:NRZ, 3:PAM3, 4:PAM4)} sets the modulation scheme and {Input waveform type} sets the type of input. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: signal
ports.summary: Fixed step discrete input signal scalar

ports.name: clock
ports.summary: Saturated but sampled clock waveform scalar

ports.name: clock_time
ports.summary: Exact time of clock transition scalar

ports.name: DecisionThreshold
ports.summary: Voltage at which latched output switches polarity scalar

ports.name: sample
ports.summary: Sample output value at clock edge scalar | -1 | -1

params.name: Clock edge
params.values: Determine when input signal is sampled Rising (default) | Falling

params.name: Output mode
params.values: Determine output sample mode Continuous (default) | Latched

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Select simulation mode Code generation (default) | Interpreted execution

params.name: DecisionThresholdPort
params.values: Turn on decision threshold port on (default) | off

params.name: Latch decision threshold
params.values: Voltage at which latched output switches polarity 0 (default) | scalar

params.name: Latch sensitivity
params.values: Voltage above or below decision threshold needed to assure that latched output switches to correct polarity 0 (default) | scalar

params.name: Symbol time (s)
params.values: Time of single symbol duration 100e-12 (default) | real positive scalar

params.name: Sample interval (s)
params.values: Uniform time step of waveform 6.25e-12 (default) | real positive scalar

params.name: Input waveform type
params.values: Type of input waveform Sample (default) | Impulse
